title: Runtime operations
description: Runtime attempts, latency, capacity, stages, viewer, jobs, plugins and telemetry health (Runtime Observability Blueprint, package.md §12.1).

list.name: app
list.label: Application
list.description: Local default matches unlabeled series. Hosted provisioning binds this to exactly one application.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Runtime telemetry is recorded by the API's ingest route. A constant, so Loki selectors stay exactly service_name=~"$service", which Tau Cloud rewrites per environment.

list.name: outcome
list.label: Outcome
list.description: Filters the runtime.operation drill-down; the event is written only for these outcomes and capacity issues.

panels.title: Telemetry Enabled
panels.description: tau_telemetry_runtime_enabled: 1 where TAU_RUNTIME_TELEMETRY resolves on for this API, else 0. Every other panel here is empty while it reads 0.

defaults.noValue: no gauge: the API predates runtime telemetry

panels.title: Attempts / min
panels.description: Settled attempts of every operation and outcome, all populations.

defaults.noValue: No runtime telemetry in this window. If Telemetry Enabled reads 0, runtime telemetry is disabled on this deployment.

panels.title: Completed Success Rate
panels.description: Succeeded / completed attempts (completed = every outcome except superseded, cancelled and abandoned; package.md §1.3).

defaults.noValue: No runtime telemetry in this window. If Telemetry Enabled reads 0, runtime telemetry is disabled on this deployment.

panels.title: Implementation-Failure Rate
panels.description: Completed attempts with cause implementation (failed, discarded, implementation-class issues) over completed attempts.

defaults.noValue: No runtime telemetry in this window. If Telemetry Enabled reads 0, runtime telemetry is disabled on this deployment.

panels.title: Render p95
panels.description: Client-observed duration of succeeded renders, submission to settlement.

defaults.noValue: No runtime telemetry in this window. If Telemetry Enabled reads 0, runtime telemetry is disabled on this deployment.

panels.title: Signed-In Users Today
panels.description: Distinct signed-in principals with an attempt today (HyperLogLog, ±0.81 %), read with max across Machines, never summed. Signed-out users are not counted, by design.

defaults.noValue: No runtime telemetry in this window. If Telemetry Enabled reads 0, runtime telemetry is disabled on this deployment.

panels.title: Outcome Mix by Operation

defaults.noValue: No runtime telemetry in this window. If Telemetry Enabled reads 0, runtime telemetry is disabled on this deployment.
